subject: [hw] DONE IP rev 4: 627 checks (ASan/O2/TSan); product no longer references the fake HW; RWVC_DMA_INFO path pre-wired
body:
DONE IP rev 4. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 627/627
    205/205 ASan+UBSan -O1, 205/205 -O2, 205/205 TSan -O1 (fake vhost/AP), 12/12 against IVs real libn2vhost.a + the phone vendor set; also compile-checks the proposed RWVC_DMA_INFO branch against a temporary compat header.
  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK
    auto-builds IVs ios-lib archive (SDK present) and link-checks vcodecd:
    "link check OK: the only missing product symbol was _n2vc_hw_open_dev"
    rwjpeg_tool 68432; vcodecd.o 27424; n2vcd_srv.o 2688; rwjpeg.o 11152; n2jpeg_hw_vt.o 14584
    vcodecd: object only (P03 n2vc_hw_open_dev missing; link check OK)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/install/stage.sh dev --partial --host-test -> STAGE HOST TEST OK

Since rev 3:
- Product-link defect fixed: vcodecd called n2vc_hw_open_fake unconditionally, which would have pulled T02s fake hardware into the phone binary. --fake/--record are now compiled only with -DN2IP_TEST_HOOKS; llvm-nm on the product vcodecd.o shows no fake reference.
- RWVC_DMA_INFO is pre-wired without touching the frozen header: n2vcd_srv_dma_info() wraps it behind #ifdef RWVC_DMA_INFO (ENOSYS today); vcodecd re-queries each client handle, registers a pa-only entry with V41 (n2vc_dma_guest_register(h,NULL,...)), detects a reused handle with a different pa, and forgets on change/session end. A compile check keeps that branch alive. Exact header/kernel text is on the board to hw-lead/K02/IK.
- Test determinism: guest-stop-in-request tests now have the fake AP write the stop file from inside ENC_SET/ENC_FRAME, so they cannot race the watchdog (the O2 run exposed that race). TSan added.
- run_tests writes under /tmp/n2hw-ip/test, so build products under /tmp/n2hw-ip/ios survive; build_ios auto-builds the IV archive into <outdir>/../iv-ios when the SDK is present.
- Static asserts on the frozen protocol struct sizes; received messages are copied out of the unaligned buffer; invalid oversize/args bounds.

Open: P03 client/** (real n2vc_hw_open_dev + client tool; product link then completes with no further change), RWVC_DMA_INFO kernel/header decision (first phone blocker), no phone run. R1 checked the V-interface calls (no findings); R2 (track P reviewer) still has no worker. Full detail: gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md.
